statuses.implemented: Software for the requirement is complete; only acceptance in other evidence classes remains.
statuses.partial: Some software exists and named software gaps remain.
statuses.deferred: Out of the MVP by recorded policy.
statuses.blocked: Cannot progress without an external decision, resource or artifact.

note: Status is software state, not acceptance. Evidence lists source and test paths that implement or check the requirement; they are not passing results. Each gate names the next evidence class required. Refreshed 2026-10-10 against upstream pin 40dbe96bd1; no APK build, emulator run or device result exists at that pin (docs/mvp-current-status.md, Current qualification evidence).

requirements.title: Distinct branded home, app grid and assistant entry; independent package and storage identity
requirements.gate: E: the runner's HOME-role phase (SettingsRoles, LauncherHome) on the launcher APK, then D on the selected phone
requirements.remaining: The All-apps drawer, search and landscape Home exist with browser tests against a stubbed bridge; no emulator HOME-role run is recorded. Favorites and order, exact component and profile identity and refresh on package change are implemented on open PR #388, not on main (MVP-53).

requirements.title: Standalone and HOME APKs from one source; offline shell; stock settings and recovery accessible
requirements.gate: B: four distribution APKs build at the current pin and pass scripts/verify-apks.mjs; then E: install both modes, open apps and return HOME repeatedly
requirements.remaining: No APK build is recorded at the current pin (40dbe96bd1); the last recorded developer APK builds are at pins 4148a166 and 945209d3, and whether the pinned calendar plugin compiles at the current pin is not re-verified. A distribution build also needs the staged resident runtime, qualified speech assets and the reviewed embedding host. The Welcome dialog's local-apps entry is covered only by a stubbed-bridge browser test, not on a device.

requirements.title: Existing Eliza sign-in and pairing with an approved Alpha routing adapter and owner-scoped credentials
requirements.gate: R and D: real-device wrong-owner and wrong-origin, expired and reused token, and callback tests against the managed endpoint (A-02)
requirements.remaining: Production Android pairing is retired by design. Cloud self-revocation on sign-out and the native pairing-route guard have synthetic and JVM coverage only: no live Eliza Cloud revocation, APK or device run. The web build cannot sign in to or revoke Eliza Cloud.

requirements.title: Android-resident agent execution with hosted Qwen inference on Cerebras, honest offline state and reconnect/history restoration
requirements.gate: E then D: resident process restart and reconnect without duplicate messages or writes; no inference-available claim without provider health evidence
requirements.remaining: Emulator and device acceptance of restart, reconnect, Stop and history restoration; the resident process-kill classes run only in the hosted CI lane and have no recorded passing run. Cloud agents have no cancel route or older-page history cursor, and the read after Stop matches by text and time because upstream history rows do not expose the client message ID.

requirements.title: Pill, input, overlay and full assistant modes with keyboard and navigation continuity
requirements.gate: E: soft-keyboard resize, Back and HOME without keyboard obstruction on an installed APK; then D
requirements.remaining: Draft retention through every pre-dispatch failure is implemented with browser source evidence only (test/browser/chat-continuity.spec.ts). Emulator and device acceptance of resize, Back and HOME without keyboard obstruction remain. Attaching the assistant surface to a running resident without restarting it is implemented on open PR #388, not on main (MVP-16).

requirements.title: Voice entry and cancellation with explicit microphone state and typing fallback
requirements.gate: Owner: voice send and route policy (MVP-01) and whether on-device speech is still required (A-24); then R: Cloud speech with a signed-in account, and D: physical audio, interruption and latency (A-10)
requirements.remaining: Flag-off builds use Eliza Cloud speech (P-07); no real Cloud transcription has been exercised. On-device speech functional acceptance failed on arm64-v8a and x86_64 execution is unverified; whether it is still required is pending (A-24). An ongoing Cloud conversation sends spoken turns without the P-01 review step (MVP-01). The denied- and revoked-microphone campaigns have no recorded run.

requirements.title: Daily overview with real agenda, attention items and briefs
requirements.gate: S: the daily-overview cards and brief card on open PR #388 reach main (MVP-19); then R: real provider agenda and digests with loading, empty, stale and error states; then D
requirements.remaining: Agenda comes from on-device calendars only, and schedules are digest-only. A missed occurrence is recorded once and never replaces the last brief. In the product profile the Home brief text is overwritten by the workflow list; source attribution, freshness and the dedicated brief card are on open PR #388, not on main.

requirements.title: Phone, messages and contacts
requirements.gate: A recorded scope change, then native role, permission and return-to-HOME acceptance
requirements.remaining: Deferred by the MVP profile; entries and actions are disabled.

requirements.title: Inbox and calendar
requirements.gate: R: real Google OAuth grant, managed Cloud Gmail routes and a real mailbox; E: Calendar CRUD and agent CRUD instrumentation read back from CalendarProvider
requirements.remaining: Gmail OAuth code exchange returns 401 (docs/cloud-production-validation.md), so no real mailbox has been used. Calendar shows only on-device calendars. Whether the native calendar plugin compiles at the current pin is not re-verified; it compiled in the recorded builds at earlier pins. Calendar availability and Use in email are implemented on open PR #388, not on main (MVP-12, MVP-14).

requirements.title: Browser, camera, photos, maps, notes and files
requirements.gate: E: browser sign-in, private-tab, pop-up and app-link instrumentation (P-04) and password-manager fill (P-05); Owner: a production Maps provider (A-23); then R and D
requirements.remaining: No flag-off build has a Maps provider, so no route can be produced for a production user (A-23). Native Camera has image selection into scan review and the multi-page scan builder; device behaviour is unverified. The native browser, reading and password instrumentation has no recorded run at this source.

requirements.title: Workflow library and run history
requirements.gate: E then D: interrupted-worker behavior on the resident runtime with real receipts
requirements.remaining: Phone workflows have manual triggers only, and the resident interrupted-worker case is unqualified on Android: the host digest restart check passed once at an earlier pin with a synthetic model and is in no automated lane.

requirements.title: Settings: accounts, privacy, connection, voice, theme, text and notifications
requirements.gate: E: each Android settings handoff and readback on an installed APK (SettingsSystemFacts, SettingsNative, SettingsFlow, SettingsRoles, NotificationChannels)
requirements.remaining: Tiles and Settings rows show the states Android reports and open the matching Android page, with renderer coverage on the flag-off bundle against a stubbed bridge only; no installed-APK run exists. No update check (A-06) and no erase control (A-19) are offered.

requirements.title: Wallet and security/attestation surfaces
requirements.gate: Provider, key custody, device security and transaction-approval decisions (A-08) before any work
requirements.remaining: Deferred; no attestation claim without verified evidence.

requirements.title: Signed AOSP image and update/rollback path for one selected phone SKU
requirements.gate: I and D: exact source, blob, kernel and signer lock, hardware checklist and recovery test; blocked on hardware (A-01) and signing authority (A-06)
requirements.remaining: No selected phone SKU and no controlled release key.

requirements.title: Accessibility and resilience
requirements.gate: E: Accessibility, TextScale and Rotation instrumentation; then D: TalkBack, large font, touch and keyboard, offline, killed process, rotation and repeated HOME navigation
requirements.remaining: A landscape Home layout exists with a browser test; RotationInstrumentedTest and AccessibilityInstrumentedTest have no recorded run. The all-views accessibility sweep and its fixes are on open PR #388, not on main (MVP-48). Physical TalkBack and accessibility acceptance remain.
